notes: v2.128 (2026-11-23, morning run): 127th tower 'Carolers' (two carolers side by side with songbooks — hat tips over hat brims, faces, bodies, books, and a base row, 33 blocks, 7 clusters sizes 13/5/5/3/3/2/2, all 4 colours, no singletons, 0 canonical duplicates) + 124th co-play prompt (sing a tiny call-and-response together — parent sings 'la… la… la!' and claps twice, Liam answers any way he likes; take turns being the leader; keep it tiny, one short line then a pause; a soft shaker or pot lid works as the beat). Carol-singing research: call-and-response is the toddler singing form — leader hands over one line at a time, nobody needs the words in advance, and turn-taking/listening are the payoff (ZERO TO THREE, NAEYC/Ella Jenkins); singing together builds language, memory, and belonging, even the quiet child 'singing' silently (Stanford Bing).
